title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-21 00:19:40 最新章节：第483章 那一剑的锋芒
content_zh:
一楼！
...
许渊表情极不稳定，时哭时笑。
好消息，他穿越成了一个家族的族长，这辈子锦衣玉食，吃穿不愁！
坏消息，他有一个儿子，三年前突然成了废材！
面对如此熟悉的剧情，即便他是一族之长，拥有凌空境的实力，也彻底慌了！
要知道，这方世界无比危险！
一个凌空境在这宣城，或许可以称王称霸！
可到了外边，也不过是一只蝼蚁而已！
许渊可不想随随便便就被儿子招惹的大人物，一根指头碾死。
幸好...
【慈父系统】及时绑定。
作为慈父，他要做的，就是为儿子保驾护航！
儿子一但得罪无敌强者，他就可以获得与对方同等的修为，并且同阶无敌！
而且还会随机触发一些任务，有极大概率获得其他奖励！
自此...
许渊便立志这辈子做一个负责任的好父亲！
当然，他只是单纯的想为儿子保驾护航而已...
提升修为什么的，只是顺带。
可后来他发现，剧情好像和自己想象中的区别有点大！

傻儿子太过胆小，整日唯唯诺诺，走路都不敢抬头，更别说惹是生非了。
简直乖的不像一个气运之子！
而他作为一族之长，根本没有哪个不开眼的，去专门找傻儿子的麻烦。
这让他怎么提升...不，培养儿子呢？
这样自然是不行的！
一个男人，若不经历风雨，又如何成长？
就算成长起来，那也只不过是温室里的花朵而已！
所以，他毅然决然的，做了一个局。
假装修为全失，布局一月，最后在今日，成功被撸下家主之位！
这一个月，许渊可是没少被嘲讽欺压。
但为了儿子的成长，这点苦又算得了什么？
“可怜天下父母心啊...”
许渊来到窗前，缓缓抬起眸子，眼神深邃看向远方的天际。
此时他的背影，带着那么一点沉重，眼神却又有几分莫名的期待...
...
太阳即将落山之际。
许小凡低着头，默默走进许家大门。
content_en:
First floor!
...
Xu Yuan's expression was extremely unstable, crying and laughing sometimes.
Good news, he traveled through time and became the patriarch of a family. In this life, he will be well clothed and have no worries about food and clothing!
Bad news, he has a son who suddenly became useless three years ago!
Facing such a familiar plot, even though he was the leader of a clan and had the strength of the Sky Realm, he was completely panicked!
You know, this world is extremely dangerous!
A volleying realm might be able to dominate Xuancheng!
But outside, he is nothing more than an ant!
Xu Yuan didn't want to be crushed to death by a single finger by a big shot his son provoked.
Fortunately...
[Loving Father System] Bind in time.
As a loving father, what he has to do is protect his son!
Once the son offends an invincible strong man, he can gain the same level of cultivation as the other person and become invincible at the same level!
And some tasks will be triggered randomly, with a high probability of obtaining other rewards!
Since then...
Xu Yuan is determined to be a good and responsible father in this life!
Of course, he just wanted to protect his son...
What about promotion and cultivation? It’s just incidental.
But later he discovered that the plot seemed a bit different from what he imagined!
The silly son is too timid and subservient all day long. He dare not raise his head when walking, let alone cause trouble.
He is simply too good to be a child of luck!
And as the leader of the clan, there is no one who would be blind to look for trouble specifically for his stupid son.
How does this allow him to improve... no, how to train his son?
Of course this is not possible!
How can a man grow if he does not experience ups and downs?
Even if they grow up, they are just flowers in a greenhouse!
Therefore, he resolutely made a game.
Pretending to have lost all his cultivation, he planned for a month, and finally today, he was successfully removed from the position of head of the family!
This month, Xu Yuan has been ridiculed and bullied a lot.
But for the sake of my son’s growth, what does this little pain mean?
"How pitiful the hearts of parents in the world..."
Xu Yuan came to the window, slowly raised his eyes, and looked deeply at the distant sky.
At this moment, his back looked a little heavy, but his eyes looked a bit inexplicably expectant...
...
The sun is about to set.
Xu Xiaofan lowered his head and silently walked into the Xu family door.
